reels.title: A New World
reels.notes: V02 (19 Oct, after Stanley rejected V01 for still shots and a white hand): all 4 story shots are Veo clips: R1C hilltop hover (K1B i2v) 0.5-6.8, V2 hills 0.3-7.3, R3 lake + raindrop on indigo hand 2.0-7.6, R4 macro drop on indigo hand 0.5-6.0; end card V2. 166 credits in total today. The descent-through-clouds shot failed 3 times (Veo lifts her ears when she falls), so the reel opens on the hilltop.

evening_entry.caption:
Sky has just arrived on Earth, and everything is new 🌙

Sky is the quiet Yin spirit. She doesn't rush in; she pauses, notices and feels her way. A golden hilltop, rolling hills, a sparkling river, then a cool breeze and one small raindrop landing in her hand. In people, this Yin side is the part of you that pauses to take in a new place before you decide what it means. The gentle start is often where the real discovery begins.

What's the first thing you notice when you arrive somewhere new? Tell us below 👇

reels.title: A World to Explore
reels.notes: V01 (20 Oct): all 4 story shots are Veo clips: V1_T2 float-down + landing, arms wide 0.3-6.8; V2_T2 run + lift-off + upright float over forest 0.2-7.2; V3_T2 standing on the cliff, wave breaks 0.5-6.5; V4_T1 back view over the sea 0.3-5.3; end card V2. 28.5 s, 9.7 MB. 148 credits (4 wasted on a no-character still batch; V1/V2/V3 T1 failed QC: wing-ears, floppy ears, crouch - see LEARNINGS L8-L11).

evening_entry.caption:
Season has just landed on Earth, and he wants to see all of it ☀️

Season is the bright Yang spirit. He doesn't wait to be shown around; he jumps in, runs, flies and goes to look for himself. A sunlit hilltop, rolling hills and a river, then the edge of a cliff and an ocean bigger than anything he has seen. In people, this Yang side is the part of you that says "let's go and see" before you have all the answers. Curiosity with energy behind it is how new places get explored.

If you could explore anywhere tomorrow, where would you go first? Tell us below 👇

reels.title: The Whisper of Rain
reels.notes: V01 (21 Oct): all 4 story shots are Veo clips: V1_T2 (V1B) rain arrives, droplets above palms 0.2-6.7; V2_T1 Gui transformation (first+last frame K2->K2B) 0.3-5.2 (trimmed before the background morph, L13); V3_T1 Gui Water playing in rain, sun breaks through 0.2-7.6; V4_T1 seedling closing 0.3-6.0; end card V2. 28.5 s, 6.6 MB. 100 credits (stills were free; V1_T1 failed QC: glow blob over face, L12).

evening_entry.caption:
Sky felt the first drops of rain, and the rain felt like a friend 🌧️

Sky is the quiet Yin spirit, and when one drop touched the moon on her forehead she became Yin Water: soft, misty and patient. Yin Water is rain and dew rather than the open sea. It doesn't push. It seeps in, nourishes and lets small things grow. In people, it is the gentle side that notices how others feel, listens before it speaks and helps quietly in the background. Like rain on dry soil, a little care at the right time can wake something new.

Who is the gentle rain in your life? Tag them below 👇

reels.title: The Mighty Ocean
reels.notes: V01 (22 Oct): all 4 story shots are Veo clips: V1_T1 sea + rising wave 0.3-6.8; V2_T1 Ren transformation (first+last frame K2->K2B2) 0.2-7.8; V3_T2 surf to shore + change back (first+last frame K3->K3B) 0.2-7.4; V4_T1 ancient tree tilt-up 0.2-4.6 (trimmed before a size pop, L16); end card V2. 29.7 s, 9.4 MB. 100 credits (stills free; V3_T1 failed QC: off-model default form after 4 s, L15; K2B two tails fixed by edit, L14).

evening_entry.caption:
Season met the ocean, and the ocean met him right back 🌊

Season is the bright Yang spirit, and when he touched a giant wave he became Yang Water: the open sea, deep, strong and always moving. Ren Water doesn't trickle. It rolls forward with confidence, carries things a long way and finds a way around anything in its path. In people, it is the big-hearted, adventurous side that loves freedom, thinks big and can take on a lot without losing its flow. Like the tide, real strength can be powerful and calm at the same time.

Who is the ocean in your life, the one who carries everyone along? Tag them below 👇
